name: Hu Liang
source:
Possesses the "human crucible" special ability like his comrade Hu Yi, but his ability is specialised towards interference of the surrounding atmosphere.

Although less capable than Hu Yi at unarmed combat, his ability to jam the telepathic network of the American Agents and to heal the wounds of the injured makes him more versatile. Unlike Hu Yi, he does not look down on his opponent no matter the difference in combat prowess. 

[Spoiler] A fellow deserter from the PLA together with Hu Yi, they have worked together as mercenaries selling their services to the highest bidder after successfully escaping from the army. Hu Yi trusts him implicitly and he is concerned about her welfare. 

He dies in all three routes. [/Spoiler]
